[[Heather Meyre]] is a collector, a type of [[NPC]] that exchanges [[Trophy|trophies]] for items.

==Locations==
*[[Charr Homelands]]
**{{NPC location|Dalada Uplands}}

==Dialogue==
:''"The fight against the [[Charr]] goes badly. The Vanguard is running low on all manner of supplies. I have been tasked with fashioning makeshift weapons to use in our more "dangerous" missions. You know, those wherein the weapons and their bearers are not likely to return in working order. My father taught me much about wilderness survival, and I'm putting that knowledge to work building axeheads and spears from mantid pincers. We'll need a lot for a new offensive... but I've said too much already. Go find me 5 [[Mantid Ungula|Mantid Ungues]] and keep quiet about it. I'll pay you this in return:"''
